subject: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea
query: when does the keepsake sea come out
title: When does The Keepsake Sea come out? Dreamlight Valley's Nov. 18 expansion
answer: Disney Dreamlight Valley's next expansion, The Keepsake Sea, comes out on Nov. 18, 2026. It lets players turn into Merfolk and explore underwater, and adds villagers including Captain Jack Sparrow, Megara, Milo Thatch, Captain Hook and Wendy. Base-game owners buy it as an add-on bundle with 5,000 Moonstones.
body:
The story starts at Dazzle Beach, where players set out to awaken four Guardians across three island biomes: Shipwreck Shores, Candy Cove and the Kingdom of Oublié. As Merfolk, players can swim across surface water and dive into ripples to catch fish instantly. The expansion also adds Adventure Companions, a new companion type, starting with Dory; Flounder and Sebastian come with the Deluxe Edition. The Enchanted Pirate Ship gets a salvaging crane, a customizable sail and flag, room for up to two villagers and a decorable Captain's Cabin.

The Deluxe Edition includes 10,000 Moonstones, and owners of the Arcade Edition get the expansion on day one at no extra cost. The base game is on PC, PlayStation 4 and 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch.
in_the_news: The Nov. 18, 2026, launch date was confirmed in the 2026 Disney Dreamlight Valley showcase.

faq.q: What time does The Keepsake Sea release?
faq.a: The release date is Nov. 18, 2026; check the game's official channels for the exact unlock time in your region.

faq.q: How much is The Keepsake Sea?
faq.a: It is sold as an add-on bundle with 5,000 Moonstones; Arcade Edition owners get it free on day one.

faq.q: Who are the new villagers in The Keepsake Sea?
faq.a: Milo Thatch, Captain Jack Sparrow, Megara, Captain Hook and Wendy.

faq.q: Can you be a mermaid in Dreamlight Valley?
faq.a: Yes. The Keepsake Sea lets players transform into Merfolk to swim and explore underwater.

faq.q: Do I need the base game for The Keepsake Sea?
faq.a: Yes. It is an expansion that base-game owners buy as an additional purchase.
